functions.description: In-place, context-aware array sort. compar must be non-NULL and must match sort_t: int (*)(const void *a, const void *b, void *sdata).

import random
import string
from typing import List

# Generator for generic NUL-terminated C-string style buffers (as bytes).
# Ensures <= 4096 bytes and avoids invalid UTF-8 surrogate ranges.

ASCII_PRINT = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + string.punctuation + " "

URLS = [
    b"https://user:pass@example.com:8080/a/b/c?x=1&y=two#frag",
    b"mailto:User.Name+tag@example.org",
    b"ftp://[2001:db8::1]/file.txt",
]
DATES = [
    b"Fri, 21 Nov 1997 09:55:06 -0600",
    b"21-Nov-1997 09:55:06 -0600",
    b"10-Jul-2020 21:05:03 +0530",
]
IMAP_DATES = [
    b"21-Nov-1997 09:55:06 -0600",
    b"02-Jan-2003 02:03:04 +0000",
]
ENV_NAMES = [b"PATH", b"HOME", b"USER", b"LANG", b"SHELL", b"TERM"]
CHARSETS = [
    b"utf-8", b"UTF8", b"iso-8859-1", b"ISO-2022-JP", b"Shift_JIS", b"windows-1252",
    b"us-ascii", b"koi8-r", b"gb18030",
]
FILES = [
    b"/", b"/tmp", b"/tmp/test.txt", b"./relative/path", b"../up/one", b"C:/Windows/System32",
    b"/path/with spaces/and#chars.txt", b"/a/b/./c/../d/", b"/tmp/.hidden",
]
REGEXES = [
    b"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,31}$",
    b"(https?)://([^/]+)/?(.*)",
    b"^From .* (Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun) ",
    b"[A-Za-z]+: [0-9]+",
]
QUERY_KV = [b"a=1", b"key=value", b"k=v&x=y&z=3", b"q=%2Fpath%2Fto%2Ffile"]
B64_SAMPLES = [
    b"", b"f", b"fo", b"foo", b"foob", b"fooba", b"foobar",
]
THEMES = [
    b"Inbox", b"INBOX", b"inbox", b" MiXeD CaSe ", b"\t spaced\r\n",
]


def _rand_ascii(r: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    for _ in range(n):
        ch = r.choice(ASCII_PRINT)
        out += ch.encode('ascii')
    return bytes(out)


def _rand_utf8(r: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    # Generate valid UTF-8 sequences, avoiding surrogate code points.
    out = bytearray()
    while len(out) < n:
        choice = r.randrange(10)
        if choice < 6:
            out.append(r.randrange(0x20, 0x7F))
        elif choice < 8:
            # 2-byte UTF-8: U+0080..U+07FF
            cp = r.randrange(0x0080, 0x0800)
            out.extend(chr(cp).encode('utf-8'))
        else:
            # 3-byte UTF-8: U+0800..U+FFFF excluding surrogates U+D800..U+DFFF
            if r.random() < 0.5:
                cp = r.randrange(0x0800, 0xD800)
            else:
                cp = r.randrange(0xE000, 0x10000)
            out.extend(chr(cp).encode('utf-8'))
    return bytes(out[:n])


def _env_assignment(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    name = r.choice(ENV_NAMES)
    val = _rand_ascii(r, r.randrange(0, 40))
    return name + b"=" + val


def _url_with_query(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    base = r.choice(URLS)
    if r.random() < 0.5:
        q = r.choice(QUERY_KV)
        if b"?" in base:
            return base + b"&" + q
        else:
            return base + b"?" + q
    return base


def _imap_internaldate(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    return r.choice(IMAP_DATES)


def _regex_candidate(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    return r.choice(REGEXES)


def _path_candidate(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    return r.choice(FILES)


def _mapping_table(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    n = r.randrange(1, 6)
    lines: List[bytes] = []
    for _ in range(n):
        name = (_rand_ascii(r, r.randrange(3, 8))).replace(b":", b"_")
        val = str(r.randrange(0, 100000)).encode('ascii')
        lines.append(name + b": " + val)
    return b"\n".join(lines)


def _rfc2047_word(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    cs = r.choice(CHARSETS)
    enc = r.choice([b"Q", b"B", b"q", b"b"])
    text = _rand_ascii(r, r.randrange(3, 12))

# Target data type: printf format string

ASCII = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789"

def _rand_choice(r: random.Random, seq):
    return seq[r.randrange(len(seq))]

def _gen_word(r: random.Random, min_len=1, max_len=16):
    n = r.randint(min_len, max_len)

def _gen_path(r: random.Random):
    roots = ["/", "./", "../"]
    root = _rand_choice(r, roots)
    depth = r.randint(0, 3)
    comps = []
    for _ in range(depth):
        comps.append(_gen_word(r, 1, 8))
    leaf = _gen_word(r, 1, 8)
    ext = _rand_choice(r, ["", ".c", ".cc", ".cpp", ".h", ".log", ".txt", ".md"]) 
    joined = "/".join([c for c in comps if c] + [leaf + ext])
    if root == "/":
        path = "/" + joined if joined else "/"
    else:

    return path.replace("//", "/")

def _gen_srcfunc(r: random.Random):
    prefixes = ["main", "worker", "process", "handle", "update", "format", "printf", "log", "dispatch", "state"]
    suffixes = ["", "_fast", "_slow", "_safe", "_impl", "_v", "_r", "_x"]
    return _rand_choice(r, prefixes) + _rand_choice(r, suffixes)

def _gen_filename(r: random.Random):
    bases = ["file", "data", "input", "output", "src", "log", "msgs", "buffer", "trace"]
    exts = [".txt", ".log", ".dat", ".bin", ".c", ".h"]
    mid = ("_" + _gen_word(r,1,4)) if r.random() < 0.6 else ""
    return _rand_choice(r, bases) + mid + _rand_choice(r, exts)

def _gen_message(r: random.Random):
    templates = [
        "Hello, world!",
        "The quick brown fox jumps over %d dogs",
        "user=%s id=%u",
        "path=%s line=%d",
        "hex:%02x done",
        "value=%d name=%s",

    return base if r.random() < 0.5 else base.replace('%', '%%')

def _gen_long_string(r: random.Random):
    n = r.randint(64, 256)
    blocks = ["A", "B", "0", "x", " ", "_", "-", "."]
    s = ''.join(_rand_choice(r, blocks + list(ASCII)) for _ in range(n))
    if r.random() < 0.5:
        s = s.strip() + "\n"

def _gen_strings(r: random.Random, count: int) -> List[bytes]:
    pool = []
    pool.append(b"src.c")
    pool.append(b"func")
    pool.append(b"m")
    pool.append(_gen_path(r).encode('utf-8'))
    pool.append(_gen_filename(r).encode('utf-8'))
    pool.append(_gen_srcfunc(r).encode('utf-8'))
    pool.append(_gen_message(r).encode('utf-8'))
    pool.append(_gen_long_string(r).encode('utf-8'))
    pool.append(b"hello")
    pool.append(b"UTF-8")
    pool.append(b"/var/log/app.log")
    pool.append(b"C:\\path\\to\\file.txt")
    pool.append(b"name=value&k=v")

    pool.append(b"2025-01-02T03:04:05Z")
    pool.append(b"debug message")
    pool.append(b"warning")
    pool.append(b"error")

        pool.append(b"")
    out = []
    for _ in range(count):
        choice = r.random()
        if choice < 0.6 and pool:
            s = _rand_choice(r, pool)
        elif choice < 0.8:
            s = _gen_word(r, 1, 20).encode('utf-8')
        else:
            s = _gen_path(r).encode('utf-8')
        if len(s) > 300:
            s = s[:300]
        out.append(s)
    return out

def _pack_u32(v: int) -> bytes:
    return struct.pack('<I', v & 0xFFFFFFFF)

def _pack_i32(v: int) -> bytes:
    # Clamp to int32_t range to satisfy struct.pack('<i') constraints
    if v < -2147483648:
        v = -2147483648
    if v > 2147483647:
        v = 2147483647
    return struct.pack('<i', v)

def _pack_ul(v: int) -> bytes:
    # Use 64-bit little-endian for robustness across platforms
    return struct.pack('<Q', v & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF)

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)
    # Decide counts
    str_count = r.randint(6, 14)
    strings = _gen_strings(r, str_count)

    # Numeric pool to satisfy various FUZZ_PARAM(unsigned int/int/unsigned long)
    nums_u32 = [
        0, 1, 2, 10, 16, 31, 63, 127, 255, 256, 512, 1023, 4096,
        0x7FFFFFFF, 0x80000000, 0xFFFFFFFF,
        r.getrandbits(32), r.getrandbits(32), r.getrandbits(32)
    ]
    nums_u32 += [60, 3600, 86400, 2_000_000_000]

    # Signed ints including negatives for LogLevel clamping and general use
    nums_i32 = [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 6, 7, -2147483648, 2147483647, r.randint(-10**9, 10**9)]

    # Unsigned long candidates (treated as 64-bit here)
    nums_ul = [0, 1, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x100000000, r.getrandbits(64)]

    chunks: List[bytes] = []
    # Header: number of strings (u8)
    chunks.append(bytes([len(strings) & 0xFF]))
    # Strings with NUL terminators
    for s in strings:
        chunks.append(s + b"\x00")

    # Pack a count for u32 values then the values
    chunks.append(bytes([len(nums_u32) & 0xFF]))
    for v in nums_u32:
        chunks.append(_pack_u32(v))

    # Pack a count for i32 values then the values
    chunks.append(bytes([len(nums_i32) & 0xFF]))
    for v in nums_i32:
        chunks.append(_pack_i32(v))

    # Pack a count for unsigned long (64-bit) values then the values
    chunks.append(bytes([len(nums_ul) & 0xFF]))
    for v in nums_ul:
        chunks.append(_pack_ul(v))

    data = b"".join(chunks)
    if len(data) > 4096:
        data = data[:4096]
    return data

# This generator focuses on producing valid environment variable names and
# key/value pairs suitable for the fuzzer stubs:
# - mutt_str_getenv: wants a valid env var name [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,31}
# - envlist_set / envlist_unset: want names without '=' and typical env names
# The fuzzer harness uses FUZZ_PARAM_STR to source names/values, so we pack
# multiple interesting strings into one buffer separated by NUL. The fuzzer can
# then split them across FUZZ_PARAM_STR calls.
# Layout (NUL-separated C-strings, all ASCII, no I/O performed):
#   name1\0value1\0name2\0value2\0name3\0value3\0...
# Names obey [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,31}; values are up to 128 chars (printables).
# We include a mixture of cases: short, max-length, with underscores, digits, etc.

MAX_TOTAL = 4096

ALPHA = string.ascii_letters
ALNUMUS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_"
VAL_CHARS = (
    string.ascii_letters + string.digits + string.punctuation.replace("\x00", "") + " "
)


def _rand_name(r: random.Random, min_len: int = 1, max_len: int = 32) -> str:
    # Ensure first char is [A-Za-z_], rest [A-Za-z0-9_]
    first = r.choice(ALPHA + "_")
    # Cap total to 32 per stub logic
    nrest = r.randint(max(0, min_len - 1), max_len - 1)
    rest = "".join(r.choice(ALNUMUS) for _ in range(nrest))
    return (first + rest)[:32]


def _rand_value(r: random.Random, min_len: int = 0, max_len: int = 128) -> str:
    ln = r.randint(min_len, max_len)
    # Avoid embedded NULs and newlines; stick to visible/space
    s = "".join(r.choice(VAL_CHARS) for _ in range(ln))
    return s


def _predefined_pairs() -> List[tuple]:
    # A set of common and edge-case names with representative values
    pairs = [
        ("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/local/bin"),
        ("HOME", "/home/fuzz"),
        ("LANG", "en_US.UTF-8"),
        ("TERM", "xterm-256color"),
        ("_", "_"),
        ("A", "1"),
        ("Z9_", "val"),
        ("VERY_LONG_ENV_NAME_WITH_32_CHARS", "x" * 10),  # 32 chars name
        ("MUTT_TEST", "alpha_beta-gamma.delta+theta"),
        ("Http_Proxy", "http://localhost:8080"),
    ]
    # Ensure the 32-char name is exactly length 32
    if len(pairs[7][0]) != 32:
        pairs[7] = (pairs[7][0][:32] + ("_" * max(0, 32 - len(pairs[7][0]))), pairs[7][1])
    return pairs


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)

    parts: List[bytes] = []

    # Include some predefined good pairs first to seed environment-specific paths
    for k, v in _predefined_pairs():
        parts.append(k.encode('ascii', 'ignore'))
        parts.append(v.encode('ascii', 'ignore'))

    # Add several random pairs to increase variety
    count = r.randint(5, 25)
    for _ in range(count):
        # Mix of different name lengths and styles
        style = r.randint(0, 4)
        if style == 0:
            name = _rand_name(r, 1, 4)
        elif style == 1:
            name = _rand_name(r, 8, 16)
        elif style == 2:
            name = _rand_name(r, 16, 32)
        elif style == 3:
            # Emphasize underscores/digits in the tail
            first = r.choice(ALPHA + "_")
            tail = "".join(r.choice("_" + string.digits) for _ in range(r.randint(1, 31)))
            name = (first + tail)[:32]
        else:
            # Max length edge
            name = _rand_name(r, 32, 32)

        # Values with varying sizes
        vstyle = r.randint(0, 4)
        if vstyle == 0:
            val = _rand_value(r, 0, 8)
        elif vstyle == 1:
            val = _rand_value(r, 8, 32)
        elif vstyle == 2:
            val = _rand_value(r, 32, 64)
        elif vstyle == 3:
            val = _rand_value(r, 64, 96)
        else:
            val = _rand_value(r, 96, 128)

        parts.append(name.encode('ascii', 'ignore'))
        parts.append(val.encode('ascii', 'ignore'))

    # Also include some plain names without paired values to feed name-only requests
    plain_names = [
        _rand_name(r, 1, 3),
        _rand_name(r, 5, 12),
        _rand_name(r, 12, 24),
        _rand_name(r, 32, 32),
        "FZVAR",  # fallback used by stub when name empty
    ]
    for n in plain_names:
        parts.append(n.encode('ascii', 'ignore'))

    # Join with NUL separators so each FUZZ_PARAM_STR can consume a complete C-string
    # Ensure total size <= 4096 bytes
    out = b"\x00".join(parts)
    if len(out) > MAX_TOTAL:
        out = out[:MAX_TOTAL]
        # Ensure we end on a NUL boundary to avoid truncating a C-string mid-byte
        # If last byte isn't NUL, replace last few bytes to end with NUL
        if not out.endswith(b"\x00"):
            out = out.rsplit(b"\x00", 1)[0] + b"\x00"

    # Guarantee buffer is non-empty and NUL-terminated to satisfy C-string expectations
    if not out:
        out = b"VAR\x00VAL"
    if not out.endswith(b"\x00"):
        out += b"\x00"

    return out

import random

from typing import List

# Target: Generate an initial buffer that will be used by FUZZ_PARAM_STR in the stub
# The fuzzer stub calls FUZZ_PARAM_STR() twice:
# 1) As a mutable source buffer to be tokenized by mutt_str_sep (NUL-terminated C string)
# 2) As a delimiter-set string (characters are individual delimiters; no escaping)
#
# Our single returned bytes buffer should contain two NUL-terminated strings concatenated:
#   [tokenizable_source]\0[delim_set]\0
# The harness will likely split or feed them separately; providing both in one buffer
# gives the fuzzer useful, valid initial seeds.
#
# Design goals:
# - Produce valid, interesting tokenizable strings up to 512 bytes (per stub clamp)
# - Include variable whitespace, punctuation, quoted substrings, empty tokens, repeated
#   delimiters, and Unicode/8-bit bytes to exercise paths
# - Produce varied delimiter sets (common sets, single-char, multi-char, random mixes)
# - Always NUL-terminate both strings
# - Keep total size <= 4096 bytes

COMMON_DELIM_SETS: List[str] = [
    ",:;\t ",            # default-like
    " ,\t\n",            # space, comma, tab, newline
    "|/\\",              # path-like
    ":",                  # single colon
    ",",                  # single comma
    "\t",                 # single tab
    ";",                  # single semicolon
    " \t;:,",             # mixed whitespace and punct
    "=,;&",               # config/kv pairs
    "()[]{}<>",           # brackets
]

WORDS = [
    "alpha", "beta", "gamma", "delta", "epsilon",
    "one", "two", "three", "four", "five",
    "lorem", "ipsum", "dolor", "sit", "amet",
    "user", "name", "host", "path", "query",
]

QUOTED = [
    '"quoted text"',
    "'single-quoted'",
    '"with,comma;and:colon"',
    '"tabs\tinside"',
]

# Some 8-bit bytes to include (valid as bytes but may be non-ASCII)
EIGHT_BIT_BYTES = bytes([0xA0, 0xC2, 0xD1, 0xE9, 0xFF])

WHITES = [" ", "\t", "\n"]
PUNCTS = list(",;:|/\\+-=_&?@#%!*^")


def _rand_delim_set(rnd: random.Random) -> str:
    # Choose from common sets or synthesize
    choice = rnd.random()
    if choice < 0.5:
        ds = rnd.choice(COMMON_DELIM_SETS)
    else:
        # Build a random set of unique characters
        candidates = list(set(PUNCTS + WHITES + list(string.punctuation)))
        rnd.shuffle(candidates)
        # length 1..10 (stub caps at 16)
        ln = rnd.randint(1, 10)
        ds = ''.join(candidates[:ln])
    # Ensure not empty
    if not ds:
        ds = ",\t "
    # Trim to 16 per stub behavior
    return ds[:16]


def _random_token(rnd: random.Random) -> str:
    t = rnd.random()
    if t < 0.25:
        return rnd.choice(WORDS)
    if t < 0.45:
        # numeric-ish
        return str(rnd.randint(0, 10**6))
    if t < 0.6:
        return rnd.choice(QUOTED)
    if t < 0.75:
        # path-like
        parts = [rnd.choice(WORDS) for _ in range(rnd.randint(1, 4))]
        return "/" + "/".join(parts)
    # random ascii chunk
    alphabet = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_-."
    ln = rnd.randint(1, 16)
    return ''.join(rnd.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(ln))


def _insert_empty_tokens(seq: List[str], rnd: random.Random, delim_chars: str) -> List[str]:
    # Introduce empty tokens by inserting consecutive delimiters positions
    # We simulate by adding placeholders that will become empty between delimiters
    out: List[str] = []
    for i, s in enumerate(seq):
        out.append(s)
        if i + 1 < len(seq) and rnd.random() < 0.3:
            # Represent an empty token marker
            out.append("")
    # Also maybe start/end with empty
    if rnd.random() < 0.2:
        out = [""] + out
    if rnd.random() < 0.2:
        out = out + [""]
    return out


def _join_with_delims(parts: List[str], rnd: random.Random, delim_set: str) -> str:
    # Build a source string inserting random delimiters from the set, possibly repeated
    delims = list(delim_set)
    if not delims:
        delims = [",", " "]
    s_parts: List[str] = []
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        s_parts.append(p)
        if i + 1 < len(parts):
            rep = rnd.randint(1, 3)  # repetitions introduce runs
            d = ''.join(rnd.choice(delims) for _ in range(rep))
            s_parts.append(d)
    return ''.join(s_parts)


def _maybe_add_8bit(rnd: random.Random, s: bytes) -> bytes:
    if rnd.random() < 0.3:
        pos = rnd.randint(0, len(s))
        add = bytes(rnd.sample(list(EIGHT_BIT_BYTES), rnd.randint(1, min(3, len(EIGHT_BIT_BYTES)))) )
        s = s[:pos] + add + s[pos:]
    return s


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rnd = random.Random(seed)

    # 1) Choose delimiter set first so we can craft source using those delimiters
    delim_set = _rand_delim_set(rnd)

    # 2) Craft a list of tokens
    n_tokens = rnd.randint(3, 20)
    tokens = [_random_token(rnd) for _ in range(n_tokens)]

    # 3) Introduce empty tokens
    tokens = _insert_empty_tokens(tokens, rnd, delim_set)

    # 4) Join using random delimiters from the set
    source = _join_with_delims(tokens, rnd, delim_set)

    # 5) Optionally sprinkle whitespace around ends
    if rnd.random() < 0.4:
        source = (rnd.choice(WHITES) * rnd.randint(0, 2)) + source + (rnd.choice(WHITES) * rnd.randint(0, 2))

    # 6) Ensure size limit like the stub (<= 512 bytes); trim gracefully at boundary
    source_bytes = source.encode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
    if len(source_bytes) > 512:
        source_bytes = source_bytes[:512]

    # 7) Optionally add some 8-bit bytes to test non-ASCII handling (still valid bytes)
    source_bytes = _maybe_add_8bit(rnd, source_bytes)

    # 8) Build delimiter set bytes (ASCII, keep simple)
    delim_bytes = delim_set.encode('ascii', errors='ignore')
    if not delim_bytes:
        delim_bytes = b",\t "
    if len(delim_bytes) > 16:
        delim_bytes = delim_bytes[:16]

    # 9) Compose as two NUL-terminated strings
    out = source_bytes + b"\x00" + delim_bytes + b"\x00"

    # 10) Ensure total size <= 4096
    return out[:4096]

    return first + rest


def _repeat_digit(r: random.Random, d: str, k: int) -> str:
    return d * max(0, k)


def _num_from_bounds(n: int) -> str:
    # Return decimal string of n without any decorations
    return str(n)


def _hex_number(r: random.Random, digits: int) -> str:
    return "".join(r.choice(_HEX[:16]) for _ in range(max(1, digits))).lower()


def _octal_number(r: random.Random, digits: int) -> str:
    return "".join(r.choice("01234567") for _ in range(max(1, digits)))


def _choose_trailer(r: random.Random) -> str:
    return r.choice(TRAILERS)


def _cap_length(s: str, maxlen: int = 4096) -> str:
    if len(s) <= maxlen:
        return s
    return s[:maxlen]


def _cases(r: random.Random) -> List[str]:
    cases: List[str] = []

    # 1) Simple small numbers
    cases.append("0")
    cases.append("1")
    cases.append("42")
    cases.append("007")

    # 2) With whitespace and signs
    for ws in ["", " ", "\t\n"]:
        for sign in ["", "+", "-"]:
            cases.append(f"{ws}{sign}123")
            cases.append(f"{ws}{sign}0")

    # 3) Trailing junk
    for t in ["abc", " ", ",rest", ")", "kb", ".5"]:
        cases.append(f"123{t}")
        cases.append(f"-7{t}")

    # 4) Boundary values (decimal), with and without trailers
    for lo, hi in INT_BOUNDS:
        for n in [lo, lo - 1, lo + 1, hi, hi + 1, hi - 1]:
            s = _num_from_bounds(n)
            cases.append(s)
            cases.append(s + _choose_trailer(r))
    for lo, hi in UINT_BOUNDS:
        for n in [lo, 1, hi - 1, hi, hi + 1]:
            s = _num_from_bounds(n)
            cases.append(s)
            cases.append(s + _choose_trailer(r))

    # 5) Long digit runs to stress accumulation
    cases.append(_repeat_digit(r, "9", 256))
    cases.append("-" + _repeat_digit(r, "9", 256))
    cases.append("+" + _repeat_digit(r, "1", 512))

    # 6) Hex-like and octal-like forms (some parsers may stop at x; still valid prefix coverage)
    for pref in PREFIXES:
        # Short
        cases.append(pref + _decimal_of_length(r, 3))
        # With trailer
        cases.append(pref + _decimal_of_length(r, 4) + _choose_trailer(r))
        # Hex digits after 0x
        if pref.lower() == "0x":
            cases.append(pref + _hex_number(r, 8))
            cases.append("+" + pref + _hex_number(r, 2) + _choose_trailer(r))
        # Octal digits after 0
        if pref == "0":
            cases.append(pref + _octal_number(r, 6))
            cases.append("-" + pref + _octal_number(r, 3))

    # 7) Empty and whitespace-only
    cases.append("")
    cases.append("    ")
    cases.append("\n\t ")

    # 8) Just sign, sign + space
    cases.append("+")
    cases.append("-")
    cases.append("+ ")
    cases.append("-\t")

    # 9) Mixed whitespace + number + trailer
    for _ in range(5):
        cases.append(_rand_ws(r) + _with_sign(r) + _decimal_of_length(r, r.randint(1, 12)) + _choose_trailer(r))

    # 10) Very large decimal causing overflow
    cases.append(_repeat_digit(r, "9", 1024))

    # 11) Leading zeros and varying lengths
    for k in [1, 2, 3, 8, 16, 32, 64]:
        cases.append("0" * k)
        cases.append("+" + "0" * k)
        cases.append("-" + "0" * k)
        cases.append("0" * (k - 1) + "1")

    # Ensure uniqueness and non-empty after NUL termination rules (we allow empty case too)
    # We'll randomize order when selecting.
    return list(dict.fromkeys(cases))


def _assemble_input(r: random.Random) -> str:
    # Build a corpus-like multi-entry payload separated by newlines to seed FUZZ_PARAM_STR
    # Many fuzzers will slice or pick substrings; providing multiple entries increases variety.
    cases = _cases(r)

    # Randomly select a subset and shuffle
    r.shuffle(cases)
    take = r.randint(10, min(60, len(cases)))
    subset = cases[:take]

    # Also inject some patterned lines
    for _ in range(r.randint(5, 15)):
        ws = _rand_ws(r)
        sign = _with_sign(r)
        if r.random() < 0.3:
            # long number
            num = _repeat_digit(r, r.choice("19"), r.randint(10, 200))
        else:
            num = _decimal_of_length(r, r.randint(1, 18))
        trailer = _choose_trailer(r) if r.random() < 0.6 else ""
        subset.append(ws + sign + num + trailer)

    # Join with newlines; cap to 4096 bytes
    s = "\n".join(subset)
    return _cap_length(s, 4096)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)
    s = _assemble_input(r)
    # Ensure NUL-terminated expectation is fine: returning bytes with a trailing newline is OK;
    # the fuzzing harness will pass substrings via c_str(). We just need ASCII bytes.
    return s.encode("ascii", errors="ignore")

import random
import base64
from typing import List

def _rand_bytes(r: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(r.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))

def _make_valid_b64(r: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Create random binary payload sizes to exercise padding and block boundaries
    size_choices = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 15, 16, 17, 31, 32, 33]
    # Also include a range up to about 1024 as the stub caps input there
    if r.random() < 0.7:
        n = r.randint(0, 1024)
    else:
        n = r.choice(size_choices)
    payload = _rand_bytes(r, n)
    b64 = base64.b64encode(payload)

    # Optionally introduce line breaks at 76 chars (valid MIME style) to cover decoder whitespace handling
    # But the stub mentions contiguous without whitespace; still, some implementations accept whitespace.
    # Keep mostly contiguous; occasionally wrap.
    if n > 0 and r.random() < 0.2:
        wrapped = []
        for i in range(0, len(b64), 76):
            wrapped.append(b64[i:i+76])
        b64 = b"\n".join(wrapped)

    # Optionally add a trailing newline (common in files/streams)
    if r.random() < 0.3:
        b64 += b"\n"

    return b64


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)

    # Choose among several interesting valid patterns
    choice = r.random()
    if choice < 0.15:
        # Empty payload encodes to empty string; some decoders dislike empty input, but fuzzer bails if empty.
        # Ensure non-empty by encoding at least 1 byte.
        data = base64.b64encode(_rand_bytes(r, 1))
    elif choice < 0.30:
        # Single byte -> 'xx==' padding
        data = base64.b64encode(_rand_bytes(r, 1))
    elif choice < 0.45:
        # Two bytes -> 'xxx=' padding
        data = base64.b64encode(_rand_bytes(r, 2))
    elif choice < 0.60:
        # Multiple of 3 bytes, no padding
        n = r.choice([3, 6, 9, 12, 24, 48, 96])
        data = base64.b64encode(_rand_bytes(r, n))
    elif choice < 0.75:
        # Max sized near the stub limit to stress buffer sizing
        n = r.randint(900, 1024)
        data = base64.b64encode(_rand_bytes(r, n))
    else:
        # General case with optional wrapping/newline
        data = _make_valid_b64(r)

    # Ensure total size <= 4096 bytes
    if len(data) > 4096:
        data = data[:4096]

    return data

import random
import string
from typing import List

ASCII_WORDS = [
    b"From ", b"Subject:", b"Date:", b"Content-Type:", b"keywords:", b"tag:",
    b"key:", b"value:", b"hello", b"world", b"UTF-8", b"iconv", b"imap",
]
MONTHS = [b"Jan", b"Feb", b"Mar", b"Apr", b"May", b"Jun", b"Jul", b"Aug", b"Sep", b"Oct", b"Nov", b"Dec"]
DOW = [b"Mon", b"Tue", b"Wed", b"Thu", b"Fri", b"Sat", b"Sun"]


def _rand(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> int:
    return rng.randrange(n) if n > 0 else 0


def _rand_ascii(rng: random.Random, length: int) -> bytes:
    if length <= 0:
        return b""
    choices = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + string.punctuation + " \t"
    return ''.join(rng.choice(choices) for _ in range(length)).encode('ascii', 'strict')


def _binary_chunk(rng: random.Random, length: int) -> bytes:
    if length <= 0:
        return b""
    return bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(length))


def _rfc5322_date_line(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    dow = rng.choice(DOW)
    day = f"{rng.randint(1,28):02d}".encode()
    mon = rng.choice(MONTHS)
    year = f"{rng.randint(1970,2038):04d}".encode()
    hh = f"{rng.randint(0,23):02d}".encode()
    mm = f"{rng.randint(0,59):02d}".encode()
    ss = f"{rng.randint(0,59):02d}".encode()
    tzsign = rng.choice([b"+", b"-"])
    tzh = f"{rng.randint(0,12):02d}".encode()
    tzm = f"{rng.randint(0,59):02d}".encode()
    return b"Date: " + dow + b", " + day + b" " + mon + b" " + year + b" " + hh + b":" + mm + b":" + ss + b" " + tzsign + tzh + tzm + b"\r\n"


def _mbox_from_line(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    user = _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(3,10))
    host = _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(3,8))
    dow = rng.choice(DOW)
    mon = rng.choice(MONTHS)
    day = rng.randint(1,28)
    hh = f"{rng.randint(0,23):02d}".encode()
    mm = f"{rng.randint(0,59):02d}".encode()
    ss = f"{rng.randint(0,59):02d}".encode()
    year = f"{rng.randint(1990,2038):04d}".encode()
    return (b"From " + user + b"@" + host + b" " + dow + b" " + mon + b" " +
            f"{day:2d}".encode() + b" " + hh + b":" + mm + b":" + ss + b" " + year + b"\n")


def _keyword_file(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    tokens = [b"alpha", b"beta", b"gamma", b"delta"]
    sep = rng.choice([b" ", b"\t", b"\n"])  
    content = sep.join(rng.choice(tokens) for _ in range(rng.randint(3,10)))
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        content += b"\n"
    return content


def _lines_mix(rng: random.Random, target: int) -> bytes:
    if target <= 0:
        return b"\n"
    parts: List[bytes] = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(3, 10)):
        choice = _rand(rng, 5)
        if choice == 0:
            parts.append(_rfc5322_date_line(rng))
        elif choice == 1:
            parts.append(_mbox_from_line(rng))
        elif choice == 2:
            # Ensure bounds: long line length between 64 and max(64, target)
            hi = max(64, target)
            lo = 64
            length = rng.randint(lo, hi)
            parts.append(_rand_ascii(rng, length))
        elif choice == 3:
            ln = _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(5, 64))
            parts.append(ln + rng.choice([b"\n", b"\r\n"]))
        else:
            key = rng.choice([b"key", b"value", b"tags", b"Subject", b"From"]) + b":"
            val = _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(0, 40))
            parts.append(key + b" " + val + rng.choice([b"\n", b"\r\n"]))
        if sum(len(p) for p in parts) >= target:
            break
    blob = b"".join(parts)
    if b"\n" not in blob:
        blob += b"\n"
    return blob[:target]


def _binary_mix(rng: random.Random, size: int) -> bytes:
    if size <= 0:
        return b""
    chunks: List[bytes] = []
    hdr = b"BIN\x00DATA\x00" + rng.choice(ASCII_WORDS) + b"\n"
    chunks.append(hdr)
    remaining = max(0, size - len(hdr))
    bsize = int(remaining * 0.6)
    chunks.append(_binary_chunk(rng, bsize))
    remaining -= bsize
    pat = rng.choice([b"\x00\xFF", b"AB", b"\x7F\x80\x81", b"\r\n"]) 
    if remaining > 0:
        reps = (remaining + len(pat) - 1) // len(pat)
        chunks.append((pat * reps)[:remaining])
    return b"".join(chunks)[:size]


def _payload_variants(rng: random.Random) -> List[bytes]:
    return [
        b"",
        b"single-line-no-newline",
        b"line1\nline2\nline3\n",
        _lines_mix(rng, rng.randint(64, 512)),
        _binary_mix(rng, rng.randint(64, 512)),
        _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(256, 1024)),
        _binary_chunk(rng, rng.randint(256, 1024)),
        _keyword_file(rng),
    ]


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    variants = _payload_variants(rng)
    base = rng.choice(variants)

    if rng.random() < 0.4:
        prefix_parts: List[bytes] = []
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            prefix_parts.append(_mbox_from_line(rng))
        if rng.random() < 0.5:
            prefix_parts.append(_rfc5322_date_line(rng))
        base = b"".join(prefix_parts) + base

    if rng.random() < 0.5 and b"\n" not in base:
        base += b"\n"

    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        pad_len = rng.randint(0, 64)
        base += _binary_chunk(rng, pad_len)

    if len(base) > 4096:
        base = base[:4096]

    return base
